description: A signed-out visitor following an agent's approval link lands on a plain 'Sign in' screen with no mention that an agent pairing is waiting and no explicit 'create an account' path in the card; new users must notice the header button or the small 'New here? Sign up free' line.
expected: Context line such as 'Sign in or create an account to approve your agent (code KHSP-BDBQ)', with sign-up as an equal option.
actual: Generic 'Sign in' heading; Clerk card (not renderable here) plus 'New here? Sign up free' below.
suggested_fix: Show the pending-agent context and both choices on the redirect page.

description: /connect for an unknown or expired code sends a signed-out user to sign-in first; the wrong-code message appears only after signing in.
expected: Fail fast or accept the detour, but tell the user the code may have expired.
suggested_fix: Low priority; mention the 10-minute lifetime on the sign-in page.

description: After entering a code manually, the URL stays /connect, so a reload loses the pairing request.
evidence: agent-browser get url after Continue; screenshots/step-4.png
suggested_fix: Push the code into the URL (replaceState).

description: quickstart.md begins with 'Sign up' while /llms.txt, which is what the agent reads, has no sign-up step; the order differs by surface.
actual: quickstart step 1 'Create your account at /sign-up'; llms.txt has only 'The approval link asks the human to sign in'.
suggested_fix: Add one line to llms.txt: 'No account yet? The link lets you create one.'
